touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Waddington qualifies as a local detour through RAF Waddington Heritage Centre and Avro Vulcan. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Waddington: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Waddington offers RAF Waddington Heritage Centre, Avro Vulcan, Waddington Aircraft Viewing Enclosure (WAVE) within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: RAF Waddington Heritage Centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with RAF Waddington Heritage Centre and Avro Vulcan, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
